checks.topic: GAA-004 candidate generation, ordering and filters
observations: Service emits fret arrays, score/category and barre fields, sorts ascending DifficultyScore, and filters played fret zero with noOpenStrings.
Tests assert known queries including C are nonempty and C scores are sorted. This static inspection does not establish a fresh pass or exact teaching-shape generation.
Independent note arithmetic verifies open C [-1,3,2,0,1,0] -> C,E,G,C,E; A-form [-1,3,5,5,5,3] -> C,G,C,E,G; E-form [8,10,10,9,8,8] -> C,G,C,E,G,C in low-to-high standard tuning.

checks.topic: GTR-003 comfort, difficulty and barre distinctions
observations: Comfort span is max-minus-min over positive frets only; all three fixture spans are 2.
Full-barre exclusion requires four or more occurrences of the lowest positive fret. A-form has two minima at 3 and E-form three at 8, so neither meets it.
Physical analyzer's separate predicate requires three adjacent equal positive frets: A-form true, E-form false.
Physical difficulty includes fret-distance span, barre flag, absence of open strings and distinct-positive-fret finger estimate; score caps at 10. Course does not equate it to individual comfort.
Default tuning text is E2,A2,D3,G3,B3,E4; indexed pitches are highest string first. Strings 4 and 3 map to D3/G3.
A=52/59, B=54/61, C=54/57 follow stated frets. A->B moves +2/+2 with seven-semitone intervals and one shared pair, predicting one Fifths issue and IsClean false.
A->C moves +2/-2 with target difference 3, predicting no issue; the lesson correctly warns it changes the target harmony.

Detector intersects played string keys, needs at least two, requires nonzero same-direction movement and checks absolute pitch difference modulo 12 for 7 or 0. It does not follow cross-string voice continuity.
Tests construct fret-zero positions with arbitrary supplied MIDI, correctly distinguished from physically consistent teaching fixtures. No execution was performed.

checks.topic: COG-002 historical label and callback boundaries
observations: Component specifies zero-based high-to-low string indices and E,B,G,D,A,E default tuning. Demo does not override tuning.
Independent pitch-class arithmetic yields E,C,G,E,C,G; displayed labels E,C,G,E,C,C match five of six. G remains a C-major chord tone.
String-label and fret-number props do not suppress optional position labels. Click callback creates only {string,fret}.
Pinned source establishes no note-answer/confidence input, scored learner session or intervention. Historical marker mismatch is not asserted as current deployed behavior.

checks.topic: COG-003 Brier arithmetic and study qualifiers
observations: Synthetic outcomes [1,1,0,1,1,0], squared losses [0.01,0.04,0.49,0.16,0.01,0.81], sum 1.52, accuracy 4/6 and mean 0.253333... are correct.
Using contaminated C key on trial six changes total to 0.72 and mean to 0.12 without changed predictions.
The p=0.9 bin has 2/3 accuracy and gap 0.233333....
Expected loss q(1-p)^2+(1-q)p^2=(p-q)^2+q(1-q); for q=0.7 losses 0.21 at p=0.7 and 0.25 at p=0.9 differ by 0.04.

The lesson preserves binary chosen-answer correctness as its event, pre-feedback recording, synthetic-data boundaries, held-out next-day comparison, uncertainty and accuracy guardrail. It does not claim a real benefit or diagnose calibration from six invented items.
